That's what I thought. You may want to include some blurb at the top
or bottom of the page that lists the changes (that were errata) that can
now be found in the updated rulebook. I'm sure that there are a lot of
people who just keep up with the errata. They figure that they already
know the rules and so why get the updated rulebook. With that little
blurb, those people would know that there are changes not details in
the errata page.
Just a suggestion.

Sorrow
